## v0.4.3

### Improvements

- Audio processing and virtual-mic reliability: safer audio routing, Windows default devices restored per role, hardened DSP buffers and pipeline behavior.
- Installer fully stops and replaces the old install; the uninstaller now reports locked files.
- Installer verifies downloads before use.
- Voice models are published once (`models-v1`) instead of with every release, so releases are much smaller.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/Sordino/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3
